annotations.title: Ask Soofi Digital to fix the website

description: Sends the user's request for help fixing their website to Soofi Digital's team, who will contact them by email or WhatsApp. Only use when the user explicitly asks for help or for Soofi Digital to contact them, and only with contact details the user has given you for this purpose. Confirm the details with the user before sending.

message.description: Optional: what they want help with, in their words

phone.description: Optional WhatsApp/phone number with country code, e.g. +1 555 123 4567

website.description: The website they want help with

name: request_help
